lines.en: Dashes gracefully through the grass.

lines.zh: 跳跃着前进，布袋随风摇摆。
lines.en: Hops forward, bundle swaying in the breeze.

lines.zh: 摇摆着布袋，小心地行走。
lines.en: Sways its bundle as it walks carefully.
Jumps lightly between the leaves.

lines.zh: 布袋里装满了种子和果实。
lines.en: Its bundle is filled with seeds and fruit.
Bends to avoid sharp objects.

lines.zh: 用布袋中的东西填充自己的肚子。
lines.en: Fills its stomach with things from the bundle.

lines.zh: 在阳光下享受布袋中的美味。
lines.en: Enjoys the tasty treats from its bundle in the sun.

lines.zh: 布袋里装满了各种香料。
lines.en: Its bundle is full of various spices.

lines.zh: 利用布袋中的物品抵御恶劣天气。
lines.en: Uses items from its bundle to shield against the weather.

lines.zh: 它一蹦一跳，布袋撞着背
lines.en: It hops along, the bag thumping its back.
It squeezes through a gap in the fence.

lines.zh: 它踩着落叶，尽量不出声
lines.en: It steps on leaves, trying to stay silent.

lines.zh: 它抱着布袋小跑过田埂
lines.en: It trots along the field ridge clutching the bag.
It avoids the gravel path and keeps to the grass.
It hops onto a low wall and over.
Sits on the ground, enjoying peace.

lines.zh: 低头查看布袋里的东西。
lines.en: Bends down to check the contents of its bundle.
Scratches its bundle of fur.

lines.zh: 悠闲地咬着布袋里的叶子。
lines.en: Chews on leaves from its bundle.

lines.zh: 布袋口松了，我把绳子系紧。
lines.en: The sack mouth loosens; I cinch the cord.

lines.zh: 梳理布袋，让绒毛更柔软。
lines.en: Smooths its bundle to make the fur softer.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的物品装饰自己的巢穴。
lines.en: Decorates its nest with items from the bundle.

lines.zh: 在温暖的阳光下享受布袋里的果实。
lines.en: Enjoys fruits from its bundle in the warm sun.
Hangs its bundle on a tree to dry.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的香料驱赶害虫。
lines.en: Repels pests with spices from its bundle.

lines.zh: 它把布袋垫在身下坐着
lines.en: It sits with the bag tucked under itself.

lines.zh: 它从袋口探头四下张望
lines.en: It pokes its head out of the bag and looks around.
It shakes grass clippings out of the bag.

lines.zh: 它用爪子理袋口的绳子
lines.en: It grooms the cord at the bag’s mouth.
It leans on a root and suns itself.
It presses an ear to the ground and listens.
Dashes into the grass.
Rushes to a safe place.
Hides in its bundle to avoid danger.

lines.zh: 用布袋抵挡玩家的攻击。
lines.en: Uses its bundle to defend against the player.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的物品吓跑玩家。
lines.en: Frightens the player with items from its bundle.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的果实投掷玩家。
lines.en: Throws fruits from its bundle at the player.

lines.zh: 把布袋举起来，准备吓唬玩家。
lines.en: Holds its bundle up to scare the player.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的香料迷惑玩家。
lines.en: Confuses the player with spices from its bundle.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的种子吓跑玩家。
lines.en: Scare the player with seeds from its bundle.

lines.zh: 把布袋紧抱在胸前，准备防御。
lines.en: Cradles its bundle tightly, ready to defend.

lines.zh: 它瞥见你，立刻缩了一截
lines.en: It catches sight of you and shrinks down a notch.
It steals a look at you, ready to bolt.
The bag tenses, and it hurts!
The bag inside flips, ouch!
The bag is compressed, ouch!
I'm hurt, it hurts!
The bag is damaged, it hurts!
My bag is damaged, it hurts!
The bag tears, ouch!
The bag is torn, ouch!
The bag is tight, ouch!
My bag is injured, it hurts!
Wanna dance with you!
Give me some bread, please!
Your colors are nice!
Can I rest next to you?

lines.zh: 你手上的果实好诱人啊！
lines.en: That fruit looks good!
Your house is big!

lines.zh: 你那把剑看起来很锋利！
lines.en: That sword looks sharp!
Let's be friends!
Your hat is pretty!
Let's share some food!

lines.zh: 你放下的果子它很想拿
lines.en: It badly wants the fruit you set down.
It reaches out from the bag, then pulls back.

lines.zh: 它围着你丢的面包打转
lines.en: It circles the bread you dropped.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻你的靴子，退开
lines.en: It sniffs your boot and backs off.

lines.zh: 它想要你的布，不敢靠近
lines.en: It wants your cloth but will not come near.

lines.zh: 它在远处盯着你的口袋
lines.en: It eyes your pocket from a distance.
Move, I'm going to hide!
Don't get closer, I'm hiding!

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的路，真讨厌！
lines.en: You're blocking my path!
Move, I'm hiding!
You're being rough, I'm hiding!
Don't bump into me, I'm hiding!
You're too rough, I'm hiding!
Move, I'm going into my bag!
Don't block my way, I'm hiding!
You're blocking my way!
Find a partner, let's dance!
I'm looking for a dance partner!
Let's sing a song!
I'm looking for a dance partner!
Find a partner, let's play!
Find a partner, let's dance!
I'm looking for a playmate!
Let's dance, find a partner!
I'm looking for a dance partner, let's go!
Find a partner, let's enjoy!

lines.zh: 我从布袋里探出头，寻找食物。
lines.en: I peek out of the sack, searching for food.
In the sack, I chew on grass.

lines.zh: 我找到一个安全的地方休息。
lines.en: I find a safe place to rest.
The sack is my cozy nest.

lines.zh: 我躲在布袋里，等待机会。
lines.en: I hide in the sack, waiting for an opportunity.
I sleep soundly in the sack.

lines.zh: 我从布袋中探头，窥视外面的世界。
lines.en: I peek out of the sack, observing the world.

lines.zh: 我享受着布袋带来的温暖。
lines.en: I enjoy the warmth from the sack.

lines.zh: 我从布袋里探出头，寻找新鲜事物。
lines.en: I peek out of the sack, searching for new things.

lines.zh: 我躲进布袋里，安全了许多。
lines.en: I hide in the sack, feeling safe.
The player is near, I'll avoid them.
I don't like being found.
I quietly avoid the player.
I don't want to meet the player.
I use the sack to hide.
The sack helps me avoid danger.
The player came, I'll vanish.
I quickly shrink into the sack.

lines.zh: 玩家发现了我，我要躲开。
lines.en: The player found me, I'll avoid them.
The sack blocks my view.

lines.zh: 我用布袋中的草叶做诱饵。
lines.en: I use grass in the sack as bait.

lines.zh: 我躲在布袋里，静观其变。
lines.en: I hide in the sack, watching.

lines.zh: 我用布袋中的草吸引玩家。
lines.en: I use the grass in the sack to attract the player.
I hide secrets in the sack.
The sack is my disguise.

lines.zh: 我用布袋吸引玩家的注意。
lines.en: I use the sack to draw the player's attention.
I plot in the sack.

lines.zh: 我躲在布袋里，悄悄接近。
lines.en: I sneak up, hidden in the sack.
The sack is my cover.

lines.zh: 我用布袋中的草分散玩家注意力。
lines.en: I use the grass in the sack to distract the player.

lines.zh: 用布袋里的藤蔓缠住你！
lines.en: Wrap you with vines in my bag!

lines.zh: 你躲不开我的藤蔓攻击！
lines.en: You can't escape my vine attacks!
My vines will缠住 you!

lines.zh: 别靠近我布袋里的藤蔓！
lines.en: Stay away from my vine bag!
I'll use vines on you!
Vines will bite you!
Beware my vine attacks!

lines.zh: 我的藤蔓会紧紧缠住你！
lines.en: My vines will choke you!
Vines will bind you!

lines.zh: 不要试图解开我的藤蔓！
lines.en: Don't try to free yourself from my vines!
Saci bundle spawns!
New Saci bundle appears!
Saci bundle spawns!
Saci bundle starts moving!
Saci bundle hatches!
Saci bundle pops out of the ground!
Saci bundle spawns nearby!
Saci bundle emerges!
Saci bundle starts moving!
Saci bundle appears here!

lines.zh: 火苗舔舐布袋，疼痛难忍！
lines.en: The fire bites the bag, it hurts!
I fell and my bag is damaged!
Drowned, my bag bursts!
The explosion ruptures my bag, ouch!
Hit by a projectile, my bag is damaged!
Magic hit my bag, it's damaged!
I'm starving, my bag is deflated, feed me!
Lightning hit my bag, ouch!
Fell into the void, my bag is broken!
